objective: Prefer supported choices for the actual champion, build, selected augments and offered cards; never override a reviewed incompatibility with popularity or tier.
hard_exclusion_requires: Reviewed evidence that the effect cannot trigger
Reviewed evidence that the card has no other usable benefit
Reviewed evidence that the prerequisite cannot be acquired within the modeled decision horizon
unknown_policy: Unknown is not false, weak or excluded. Role labels, missing site rows, low win rate and low pick rate cannot establish mechanical exclusion.
context_policy: All compatibility facts must refer to the offered candidate and the same champion/build/selected augment/item context; a context fingerprint is required. Unmodeled interactions prevent definitive exclusion.

source_evidence.scope: Effect description only; does not establish champion incompatibility.

limitations: No champion capability profiles are populated yet; champion role or conventional build is not a substitute.
Fixture facts are synthetic assumptions, not verified champion mechanics.
No quantitative estimate of conversion net value or recommendation ranking is implemented.
Catalog evidence cannot verify all champion, item and augment interactions.
Build-path profiles remain observational and conditional on a single augment, not the joint selected augment set or current purchased items.

build_paths.selection: Predefined paths only, per champion. All are available, one active; no custom planned item selection.
build_paths.switching: Manual switch allowed during game; preserve purchased items and selected augments, invalidate prior context reviews.
build_paths.evidence_fallback: Champion-only evidence remains explicitly unconditioned on path; no missing profile is an automatic veto.
build_paths.profile_summary: Largest published sample is an illustration, never max-WR selection or a causal estimate.

offline_evaluation.ground_truth: User feedback is optional and focuses on information sufficiency. This prototype does not need expert labels to expose source indicators.
offline_evaluation.scenario_constraints: The review suite uses source-known same-rarity offers. This alone does not establish legal offers or stage eligibility.

decision_support.purpose: Show recognizable card effects and source indicators so the player can decide without providing expert labels.
rules: Never relabel general champion tiers as selected-path tiers.
Never render OP.GG performance index as win rate or undefined popularity as percent.
Use unknown for missing data, not weakness.
Expose description fallback and unresolved values.
Do not require the user to supply the best-card label.
